# Lizard Reviews

> Guaranteed Google review removal. We use our own unique methods. We remove 100% of reviews with text. The only category outside our reach: rating-only reviews (a star with no text). 1,427 removals between January and May 2026. Pay only after Google confirms removal.

Last updated: 2026-11-21.

Lizard Reviews is a pure-play Google review removal service operating across North America and Europe. We work two motions:

- Direct-to-business: $450 per review, billed only after Google confirms removal.
- White-label fulfillment for ORM agencies: custom partnership pricing tiered by volume, modeled on a 30-min call.
- Open referral program for anyone: 10% of net fees for 12 months, published terms (see the Optional section).

Both motions are pay-on-success. We confirm acceptance in 24 hours. Removal lands within 24-48 hours of acceptance. If we don't deliver, you don't pay. The only review type we cannot remove is rating-only (a star with no text). Everything else with text is in scope.

## Key facts (year-tagged 2026)

- Reviews removed Jan-May 2026: 1,427
- Success rate on accepted cases: 100%
- Typical turnaround: 24-48 hours from accepted case
- Reviews that returned post-removal: 0
- Direct retail price: $450/review
- Agency wholesale: always custom, tiered by volume and agreed on a call
- Payment: SEPA, wire, or stablecoin · always after confirmed removal
- Founded: 2025

Standard review is $450, so the commission is $45. Paid monthly after the client has paid (clients pay only after Google confirms removal). Free to join, non-exclusive.

## Methodology disclosure

Lizard Reviews removes Google reviews with its own unique methods. We do not publish further detail because exposure would undermine their effectiveness. We do not use account compromise or fake reporting networks. We do not use SEO suppression as a substitute for actual removal.

## What we don't do

- We don't remove rating-only reviews (a star with no text). That is the one category outside our reach.
- We don't remove reviews on platforms other than Google (Yelp, TripAdvisor, etc. on roadmap)
- We don't use SEO suppression as a substitute for actual removal
- We don't compete with our agency partners for end clients
